invariants.rationale: The method uses map to access properties and methods, so it must not be null.
The method adds a layer to parentLayers, so it must not be null.
The method reads from element and calls methods on it; element must not be null.
The method expects element to have named fields (like 'type'), so it should be an object in the JSON tree.
The method immediately calls map.getProperties().get(), so map.getProperties() should be non-null.
